title: Injecting-context (transformer)
description: Input/output shape of injecting-context: injecting specialized to act on a context. The content is constrained to the context structure; the site is constrained to a Claude Code hook event name. Output is an emission record carrying the protocol envelope appropriate to the hook event.

content.description: The context being injected. References the context JSON Schema.

site.description: The Claude Code hook event receiving the injection.

output.description: An emission record per the parent injecting transformer's output schema.
